{{Vanilla|Slimeball}}
{{Infobox auto}}
A '''slimeball''' is a sticky item. [[Matcha Flavoured]] lets it be crafted from [[dough]]. [[Sulfur Goo|Sulfur goo]] is a variant.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
[[Dough]] and lime dye make 2 slimeballs, and a slime block crafts into 9.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/slime_ball_from_dough.json}}</ref>
